result.title: Benchmarks' Last Exam
result.comment: 15 pages, 6 figures, 2 tables. Initial milestone of the Benchmarks' Last Exam initiative; public reports, structured data, and code archived at https://benchmarks-last-exam.com/benchmarks/ and https://github.com/ZekkiCat/Benchmarks-Last-Exam
result.summary: Public benchmarks guide model selection, post-training rewards and claims of progress in artificial intelligence, yet leaderboards report aggregate scores without verifying whether each task's prompt, environment and grader agree on what counts as success. How often that agreement fails in contemporary evaluations, and in which direction confirmed defects move scores, has remained unmeasured across grading designs. Here we synthesize task-level quality reviews of 749 tasks across eight frontier benchmarks and 767 public model evaluations spanning closed-form question answering, document rubrics and agentic execution to assess whether prompts, environments and graders align. Task validity stratifies sharply by grading architecture. Closed-form benchmarks revised after public error reporting reach 92.5% verified validity, compared with 29.3% across six multi-step suites that nevertheless already supply 161 verified complex tasks. Rubric suites fail through mismatches between prompts and reference checklists, whereas execution harnesses add incomplete state assertions, shared-channel leaks and grading-time collisions. Across confirmed defects, 71.7% withhold credit from compliant solutions while 28.3% permit shortcut passes, indicating that raw leaderboard ceilings understate frontier capability on many practical tasks. Grading committed patches inside a fresh container cuts confirmed runtime bypasses from 14.7% in shared containers to 2.7% (a 5.5x drop, and 0% in read-only or static suites), showing how targeted maintenance restores existing benchmarks at low cost. As the initial milestone of the long-term Benchmarks' Last Exam initiative, this synthesis launches sustained expansion across wider benchmark coverage and deeper evaluation-quality dimensions so that pursuing leaderboard gains directly advances genuine model capability.

AI.brief_summary: 该文综合八个前沿基准、749 个任务的质量审查与 767 次公开模型评测，检验 prompt、环境与 grader 是否就「成功」达成一致，并按评分架构统计缺陷方向（扣分还是放行捷径）以及容器隔离修复的效果。
AI.relevance_reason: 其对「shortcut pass」与评分器缺陷的量化思路，可能可供核查 VLM/LVR 评测中答案是否真正依赖视觉证据而非捷径；论文本身不涉及多模态推理机制。
